description_en: Queries the certificates that are associated with a listener, including additional certificates and the default certificate
description_zh: 查询指定监听关联的证书，包含扩展证书和默认证书
name: ListListenerCertificates

parameters.help_en:
The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. Valid values:

You do not need to specify this parameter for the first request.
You must specify the token that is obtained from the previous query as the value of NextToken
parameters.help_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：
第一次查询和没有下一次查询时，均无需填写。
如果有下一次查询，取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken值
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return in each call. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh: 本次读取的最大数据记录。取值范围：1~100。入参为空时，默认值为20
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The listener ID. You must specify the ID of an HTTPS listener or a QUIC listener
parameters.name: listener_id

parameters.help_en: The type of the certificate. Valid values: Ca and Server
parameters.name: certificate_type

CertificateId.description_en: The certificate ID. Only server certificates are supported
CertificateId.description_zh: 证书ID，当前仅支持服务器证书

IsDefault.description_en:
Indicates whether the certificate is the default certificate of the listener. Valid values:

true
false
IsDefault.description_zh:
是否为监听默认证书。取值：

true：默认证书。

false：扩展证书

Status.description_en:
Indicates whether the certificate is associated with the listener. Valid values:

Associating
Associated
Diassociating
Status.description_zh:
证书与监听关联的状态。取值：

Associating：关联中。

Associated：已关联。

Diassociating：解除关联中

MaxResults.description_en: The maximum number of entries returned
MaxResults.description_zh: 本次请求所返回的最大记录条数
MaxResults.title_en: 本次查询返回记录数量
MaxResults.title_zh: 本次查询返回记录数量

NextToken.description_en:
A pagination token. It can be used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. Valid values:

If NextToken is empty, no next page exists.
If a value is returned for NextToken, the value is the token that determines the start point of the next query
NextToken.description_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：
如果NextToken为空表示没有下一次查询。
如果NextToken有返回值，该取值表示下一次查询开始的令牌

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries returned
TotalCount.description_zh: 本次请求条件下的数据总量
